description:
Move citation warnings out of `ArtifactPlan` into an advisory citation report beside it, computed once per command from one citation index, so the archive plan derives only from its captured image.

## Background

- Archive planning scans live citation files outside the captured image, once per plan (`collect_citation_scan_evidence` in `crates/jit/src/storage/artifact_inspection.rs`, called at `crates/jit/src/commands/archive.rs` ~819). The results become `ArtifactPlan` warnings through `ClassificationFacts::citations` (`crates/jit/src/domain/artifact_classifier.rs` ~378, ~754, ~1173, ~1196). A change to an uncaptured citing file can therefore change the plan over an identical image.
- Story `19404174` sol checkpoint review, finding 1 (REQ-01, "previewed plan equals the executed plan over the same image"). Invoker ruling: citation warnings leave the plan (`@/charter/D-18`, `@/charter/D-20`). Capturing the citation sources into the image was rejected because it charges an advisory read to the guarded capture and its budget.
- The per-plan scan is the per-candidate citation cost the c0775a83 worker profiled on archive candidates. This task removes that component ahead of the `45d0a971` cost benchmark.
- Link parsing and target resolution already exist in `crates/jit/src/document/link_validator.rs` (`scan_links`, `resolve_target`) and `RootRelativePath::resolve_link` (`crates/jit/src/domain/relative_path.rs`).
- Epic criterion: `b697a3f7` REQ-06.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `ArtifactPlan` and the classification facts carry no citation evidence or citation warnings; the archive plan derives only from its captured image.
- [hard] REQ-02: Archive preview, candidate listing and execute each scan the configured citation roots at most once per command into one index from cited target to citing files, and report citations for every artifact or candidate by lookup in that index, in an output section labelled advisory; preview and execute print the same section given the same live files.
- [hard] REQ-03: The index matches targets through the existing link scanning and resolution (`document/link_validator.rs`, `RootRelativePath::resolve_link`); no third link scanner or target resolver is added.
- [hard] REQ-04: One test owns "the previewed plan equals the executed plan when a citing file changes between them"; the index has its own unit tests; tests that asserted citation warnings inside the plan move to the advisory report or are deleted as duplicates.

## Notes

- Behaviour change: citation warnings move from the plan's warnings to a separate advisory section of the preview, candidates and execute output. Documentation describing citation warnings follows them.
title: Archive citation warnings are an advisory report beside the plan, from one index per command
